## Problem

Describe the bounded problem and user-visible impact.

## Changes

Describe the implementation, policy-semantic effects, compatibility impact, and
generated files changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were added or updated first.
- [ ] `timeout 120s go test -count=1 -timeout 60s ./...`
- [ ] Static, generation, race, architecture, or benchmark gates relevant to the change passed.
- [ ] Warmed evaluator paths remain `0 B/op`, `0 allocs/op`, or the measured change is explained.
- [ ] Commits include a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when needed.
